'''{{PAGENAME}}''' and '''Siric''' is a male Academy Affair staff NPC who appears at Night in one of the class.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Agliano:''' Have logistics bring over another half-bag of cement powder.
:'''Agliano:''' Can't believe they managed to blast a hole in it. 3D printing alone won't cut it for a patch job.
:'''Siric:''' I've seen worse. Last week at the proving grounds was a real mess.
:'''Siric:''' A student had a Forte freak-out and caused a gravity shift in a lecture hall.
:'''Siric:''' By the time I got there, everything was just... floating.
:'''Agliano:''' Ah, the new generation outdoes the old. These kids keep getting more powerful. Back in my day—
:{{DIcon}} What?
:'''Agliano:''' Oh, no. It's nothing.
:'''Siric:''' Let's wrap this up. They've got lectures tomorrow.
{{Dialogue End}}
